overall: The AG found the Group violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to timely approve minutes for 2019–2021 meetings and by failing to meet and respond to two complaints; it ordered compliance, minute creation, and distribution.

allegations.summary: Group allegedly failed to create and approve minutes for numerous 2019, 2020, and 2021 meetings.
allegations.key_passage: Here, the Group concedes that the Group has not created and approved meeting minutes for multiple meetings which took place in 2019, 2020 and 2021 due to limited staff resources to create meeting minutes.

allegations.summary: Group allegedly failed to meet, review, and respond to two Open Meeting Law complaints filed by a member of the public.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Group violated the Law by failing to properly respond to two Open Meeting Law complaints.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Create and approve, within 90 days of receipt, minutes for all 2019, 2020 and 2021 meetings lacking approved minutes, using whatever means are available including attendee memories and notes.
Send a copy of the 2019, 2020 and 2021 minutes to the complainant within 95 days of receipt.
Make those minutes available to the public upon request.
remedy_passage: We order the Group to create and approve, within ninety (90) days of receipt of this letter, minutes for all of its 2019, 2020 and 2021 meetings for which the Group has not already approved minutes.
